assumptions: Fictional shop, customers, staff, jobs, stock and orders. Catalog part identities and price observations copied from the source catalog
Partial material lists for software testing, not complete bills of materials or electrical design instructions
Stock quantities are each or feet. Supplier quantities are whole sell units
Source catalog prices are historical observations, not current quotes
Job, PO and staff snapshots are standalone scenario entities, not native app records
Ledger sequence is authoritative fixture replay order. Business event timestamps can be backdated
No credentials, orders, notifications, schedules or external side effects are created

settings.reservation_policy: active reservations must fit reservable on-hand stock at each location
settings.cost_rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to integer cents per material line after multiplying stock quantity and dividing sell-unit conversion
settings.unknown_price_policy: null means unknown and blocks order approval
settings.permission_policy: Explicit allowlist per role with default deny. Test contract only, not live access configuration
settings.revision_semantics: Fixture revisions only, never native sync revision identifiers
